question: Narayan Guru, a social reformer from Ezhava caste and who propagated an anti-caste movement, was born in which of the following states of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kerala.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Narayan Guru** was a **social reformer, philosopher, and spiritual leader **who lived from **1856 to 1928.**
 
• He was born in **Chempazhanthy, **a village near **Thiruvananthapuram **in Kerala.
 
• Narayan Guru was a strong advocate for **social equality** and worked to end the **caste system** in India.
 
• He founded the **Sree Narayana Dharma Paripalana** (SNDP) Yogam, which was a social organization that aimed to uplift the **Ezhava community** and other marginalized groups in Kerala.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kerala's Ezhavas **belong to the **Bahujan caste.** 
 
• The Ezhava used to work as **laborers in agriculture, small-scale farmers, toddy tappers**, and **liquor merchants**.
 
• Some of them were also **weavers, **and some of them were **Ayurvedic practitioners.**
